fact: On 26 March 2024 the state bureau BNETD presented a 2020 land-use map built by AI on Sentinel satellite images (62.16% cultivated land), available on an online platform and described by the Ministry of Agriculture's rural development director as a tool for the cocoa strategy.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : le BNETD présente la carte d'occupation des sols 2020 avec l'appui du programme cacao durable de l'Union européenne
